lines.en: label mayadorm25:
I knock on Maya’s door and hope that, whenever she answers, I won’t be asked to carry anything across town again.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Maya 的门，心里盼着她开门时别再让我扛着什么东西横穿整座城市了。

lines.en: As much as I like spending time with her (For whatever reason that I actually do), I’m not the biggest fan of physical activity that doesn't result in my penis being submerged in a teenager.
lines.zh: 虽说我还挺喜欢跟她待在一起的（不管出于什么见鬼的理由），但我实在不太热衷那种最后不会让我那话儿埋进一个少女体内的体力活。

lines.en: But hey- Maybe Maya will be insatiably horny tonight and go against her better judgement to finally sleep with me.
lines.zh: 不过嘛——说不定 Maya 今晚欲火难耐，一犯迷糊就终于肯跟我上床了。

lines.en: scene flavorredux1
: Oh, good. It's the last person I wanted to see.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。我最不想见的人来了。

lines.en: Or maybe she won't and I'll just have to jerk off before going to sleep tonight.
lines.zh: 也可能她不会，那我今晚睡前就只能自己解决了。

lines.en: : Hey, Maya. I just figured I'd stop by to see what you were doing tonight.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Maya。我就想着顺路过来看看你今晚在干嘛。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不？

lines.en: : You’re not beginning to think we’re friends, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会开始觉得我们是朋友了吧？

lines.en: : I know that a lot of what I’ve been saying lately could be easily misinterpreted as us getting closer, but I didn’t think you’d go this far.
lines.zh: : 我知道我最近说的很多话都容易被误解成我们在走近，但我没想到你会想偏到这个地步。

lines.en: : You know we don’t have to be friends to hang out, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我们不必是朋友也能一起玩吧？

lines.en: : Are you suggesting that we remain in each other’s company for the sole purpose of belittling one another?
lines.zh: : 你是在提议，我们待在一块儿的唯一目的就是互相贬低？

lines.en: : Sure. Whatever works for you.
lines.zh: : 行啊。你觉得怎么舒服怎么来。

lines.en: scene flavorredux2
: Hm...This may be a form of companionship I wouldn't outright reject.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这种相处方式，我倒不至于一口回绝。

lines.en: : You have given me much to think about.
lines.zh: : 你给了我不少值得琢磨的东西。

lines.en: scene flavorredux1
: Please note that I am extremely exhausted tonight, though. And that I will very likely spend this time ranting about life or the world or something.
lines.zh: : 不过请注意，我今晚累得够呛。而且我大概率会把这段时间用来抱怨人生或者这个世界什么的。

lines.en: : Just to make sure, you are the real Maya, right?
lines.zh: : 先确认一下，你是真的 Maya 吧？

lines.en: : Because having you actually agree to spending time with me so shortly after that conversation about you being swapped with a new Maya is very concerning.
lines.zh: : 毕竟在聊完「你被换成了一个新 Maya」那件事之后没多久，你居然真的同意跟我待在一起，这很让人不安啊。

lines.en: scene flavorredux3
: Yes...I’m the normal Maya.
lines.zh: : 是……我是那个正常的 Maya。

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m just exhausted.
lines.zh: : 我说了，我只是累了。

lines.en: : As much as I like confusing you, doing it every single day can get really taxing after a while.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很喜欢把你搞糊涂，但天天这么干，久了也挺费神的。

lines.en: : Well, maybe there’s something I can do to help you re-
lines.zh: : 那，也许我能做点什么帮你恢——

lines.en: scene flavorredux1
: Please don’t finish that sentence. Cleaning vomit out of this carpet is not a thing I want to be doing tonight.
lines.zh: : 求你把那句话留半截。我今晚可不想清理地毯上的呕吐物。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised you let me get as far into it as I did.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你居然让我说到了那个程度，我挺意外的。

lines.en: : As am I. I’m clearly off my game tonight.
lines.zh: : 我也是。我今晚显然不在状态。

lines.en: : Then what do you suggest we do to get you back into it?
lines.zh: : 那你建议我们做点什么，好让你找回状态？

lines.en: scene flavorredux4
: Well, in a perfect world, I’d suggest that you leave me alone and I go out to eat by myself.
lines.zh: : 要是在一个完美的世界里，我会建议你别管我，让我一个人出去吃。

lines.en: : But perfect worlds are clearly not something I have any experience with.
lines.zh: : 但完美的世界显然不是我熟悉的东西。

lines.en: : So you’re suggesting that we go out to eat together?
lines.zh: : 所以你是在提议我们一起出去吃？

lines.en: : I think what I’m suggesting is more along the lines of you following ten feet behind me and paying for my dinner.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我提议的更像是——你跟在我身后十英尺，然后替我付饭钱。

lines.en: : So kind of like that one time we went to the takoyaki truck?
lines.zh: : 有点像我们那次去章鱼烧餐车？

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : This is just another invitation to the takoyaki truck, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 这其实就是又一次章鱼烧餐车之约，对吧？

lines.en: scene flavorredux1
: Incorrect.
lines.zh: : 不对。

lines.en: : We’ll be going somewhere a little different tonight.
lines.zh: : 我们今晚去个稍微不一样的地方。

lines.en: : Different?
lines.zh: : 不一样？

lines.en: : You’ll see.
lines.zh: : 到了你就知道了。

lines.en: : But please hide your wallet, for where we're heading is very dangerous. Especially for people like you.
lines.zh: : 但请把钱包藏好，我们要去的地方非常危险。尤其是对你这种人。

lines.en: : I have many questions all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我一下子冒出很多问题。

lines.en: : Please keep them to yourself. Talking requires energy and I am scarcely low on that right now.
lines.zh: : 请把它们憋回去。说话是要耗精力的，而我现在这方面已经所剩无几了。

lines.en: scene black
Maya casually walks past me and I’m left with no choice but to follow her.
lines.zh: Maya 若无其事地从我身边走过，我只得跟上去。

lines.en: We move through the streets at a relatively brisk pace, which I imagine is only due to the fact that she’s hungry.
lines.zh: 我们步子相当快地穿过街道，我猜这纯粹是因为她饿了。

lines.en: One thing I’ve noticed about her is that the only time she ever moves with any sense of urgency is when there is food involved.
lines.zh: 我注意到她一个特点：只有跟吃的相关的事，她才会显出一点紧迫感。

lines.en: And given that she likely won’t be paying for herself tonight, I can only imagine how excited she must be...
lines.zh: 再想想今晚多半不用她自己掏钱，她有多兴奋我就可想而知了……

lines.en: scene mayamaid1
: Maya, where did you bring me?
lines.zh: : Maya，你把我带到哪儿来了？

lines.en: : Hell.
lines.zh: : 地狱。

lines.en: : Hell is a lot...brighter than I expected it to be.
lines.zh: : 地狱比我预想的要……亮得多啊。

lines.en: : You should see the other place.
lines.zh: : 你是没见过另一个地方。

lines.en: : Is this a-
lines.zh: : 这是不是一家——

lines.en: : Maid cafe. Bingo.
lines.zh: : 女仆咖啡厅。答对了。

lines.en: : Why did you bring me to a maid cafe in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 你为什么大半夜把我带到女仆咖啡厅来？

lines.en: : And why are they even open this late?
lines.zh: : 还有，他们怎么这么晚还营业？

lines.en: scene mayamaid2
: I didn’t bring you anywhere. You followed me here. Remember?
lines.zh: : 我没带你来任何地方。是你自己跟过来的。记得吗？

lines.en: : Well, since I followed you here, I assume you’re going to be paying for yourself then?
lines.zh: : 既然是我跟过来的，那我猜你今晚要自己付账了？

lines.en: : No. There is an admission fee for spending time with me. You may use that to cover tonight's bill.
lines.zh: : 不。跟我待在一起是要收入场费的。你可以拿那个来付今晚的账单。

lines.en: : Also, I seem to have misplaced my wallet.
lines.zh: : 另外，我好像把钱包弄丢了。

lines.en: : Whatever will we do?
lines.zh: : 那我们可怎么办呀？

lines.en: : Okay, I'll pay for you. But-
lines.zh: : 行，我替你付。不过——

lines.en: : Thank you for accepting my conditions without asking for anything in return. I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你无条件接受了这些条件，我很感激。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and lean back in my chair, receiving the answer I more or less expected.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，往椅背上一靠，得到了一个我多少预料到的答案。

lines.en: This is the first time I’ve been to a maid cafe since waking up in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 这是我在 Kumon-mi 醒来之后第一次来女仆咖啡厅。

lines.en: I didn’t even know one of these existed here, but I guess it makes sense given that virtually everything else seems to exist here as well.
lines.zh: 我甚至不知道这地方也有这么一家，不过想想也是——这里好像什么都有的样子。

lines.en: I wonder why there are no other customers, though?
lines.zh: 不过，怎么一个别的客人都没有呢？

lines.en: : Is this...somewhere you come often?
lines.zh: : 这地方……你常来吗？

lines.en: scene mayamaid1
: Lately, yes.
lines.zh: : 最近常来。

lines.en: : It’s surprisingly cheap for the sizable portions they give you.
lines.zh: : 分量给得那么足，还出奇地便宜。

lines.en: : Plus, maids are cute.
lines.zh: : 而且女仆很可爱。

lines.en: : But I’m sure you already know this given that all you think about are [young_girls].
lines.zh: : 不过你肯定早就知道了，毕竟你满脑子想的都是 [young_girls]。

lines.en: : Can you say “Maids are cute” again really quick? It was really out of character and I want to engrain it into my memory.
lines.zh: : 你能不能再快点说一遍「女仆很可爱」？这句话实在太不像你了，我想刻进记忆里。

lines.en: : I refuse.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝。

lines.en: scene mayamaid2
: Ah! You’re back!
lines.zh: : 啊！你回来了！

lines.en: : I must have missed you at the door, Princess Maya!
lines.zh: : 我刚才在门口居然没接到你，Maya 公主！

lines.en: : For the millionth time, just Maya is fine.
lines.zh: : 我说过一百万次了，叫 Maya 就行。

lines.en: : Being called a princess makes me nauseous.
lines.zh: : 被人叫公主会让我反胃。

lines.en: : You’ll always be a princess to me.
lines.zh: : 对我来说你永远是公主。

lines.en: scene mayamaid3
: I will destroy you.
lines.zh: : 我这就毁灭你。

lines.en: scene mayamaid4
: Oh! You brought a new customer this time! And he’s so handsome as well!
lines.zh: : 哦！这次你带了新客人来！而且他还这么帅！

lines.en: : Good evening, Master!
lines.zh: : 晚上好，主人！

lines.en: : My name is Uta-chan and I’ll be taking veeeeery good care of you today~!
lines.zh: : 我叫 Uta-chan，今天会好——好——好地照顾您哦～！

lines.en: scene mayamaid5
: So if there’s aaaaanything you need, feel free to let me know and I’ll do whatever I can to make your deepest desires come true!
lines.zh: : 只要您有任——何——需——要，尽管跟我说，我会尽我所能让您最深的愿望成真！

lines.en: : You will immediately regret saying that to him.
lines.zh: : 你马上就会后悔对他说这种话。

lines.en: : Your wish is my command while you’re inside this cafe, Master! Anything you want, you can have!
lines.zh: : 在这家店里，您的愿望就是我的命令，主人！您想要什么，就能有什么！

lines.en: : Please marry me.
lines.zh: : 请嫁给我。

lines.en: : Awww! That's so, so sweet of you!
lines.zh: : 呜哇！您真是太、太贴心了！

lines.en: scene mayamaid6
: But unfortunately, us maids are forbidden from marrying any of our guests. It's just one of the rules here, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 但很不巧，我们女仆是禁止和客人结婚的。这是这里的规矩之一，真是遗憾。

lines.en: : I will wait for you forever.
lines.zh: : 我会永远等你。

lines.en: scene mayamaid7
: Can I order dinner now? Or do you want to hit on Uta-chan some more?
lines.zh: : 我现在能点餐了吗？还是你想继续撩 Uta-chan？

lines.en: : I’d like to hit on Uta-chan some more if that's okay.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我想再撩一会儿 Uta-chan。

lines.en: : It's not.
lines.zh: : 不可以。

lines.en: : Sorry, Princess Maya. I was just so excited to see a new face that I almost lost myself for a second.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Maya 公主。我只是看到新面孔太兴奋了，一时差点失态。

lines.en: : But I’m here for you now! So please tell Uta-chan how she can make your dreams come true tonight!
lines.zh: : 但我现在就为您服务！所以请告诉 Uta-chan，今晚她该怎么让您美梦成真！

lines.en: scene mayamaid8
: Omurice and a black tea, and the freedom to go the rest of the night without being called a princess.
lines.zh: : 一份蛋包饭、一杯红茶，还有今晚剩下的时间里别再被叫公主的自由。

lines.en: : But you are a princess while you’re inside the cafe! And it’s my duty to make you feel more special than you’ve ever felt before.
lines.zh: : 可您在这家店里就是公主呀！让您觉得自己比以往任何时候都特别，是我的职责。

lines.en: : Call me a princess again and I am never coming back.
lines.zh: : 你再叫我一声公主，我就再也不来了。

lines.en: scene mayamaid9
: You’re more fun when you come by yourself.
lines.zh: : 你一个人来的时候比较有意思。

lines.en: scene mayamaid10
: You’ll keep on visiting me, though...Right, Master?
lines.zh: : 不过您会常来看我的吧……对吗，主人？

lines.en: : I will do anything you want me to do, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 你要我做什么我就做什么，Uta-chan。

lines.en: scene mayamaid11
: Oh? Anything, you say?
lines.zh: : 哦？你说任何事？

lines.en: : I will kill for you. All you have to do is ask.
lines.zh: : 我可以为你去杀人。你只要开口就行。

lines.en: : You don’t need to go that far, Master. As long as you’re happy, I can find it within myself to keep going on.
lines.zh: : 您不必做到那种地步，主人。只要您开心，我就能在自己心里找到继续下去的力气。

lines.en: : And also, it would make me super-duper happy if you’d buy an extra dessert or two~!
lines.zh: : 还有哦，如果您能多点一两份甜点，我会超——级开心的～！

lines.en: : I will take one of everything you have.
lines.zh: : 你们有什么我就每样来一份。

lines.en: scene mayamaid12
: E-Everything?!
: Do you see now why I said this place was dangerous for people like you?
lines.zh: : 现在明白我为什么说这地方对你这种人很危险了吧？

lines.en: : Shut up, Maya. I'm talking to Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Maya。我在跟 Uta-chan 说话。

lines.en: : You’ve made me the happiest maid in the whole gosh-darn world, Master! Thank you so, so much!
lines.zh: : 您让我成了这整个该死的世界里最幸福的女仆，主人！真的、真的太感谢您了！

lines.en: : Now, I’ll be back in a jiffy while I start getting stuff ready! But don’t miss me too much, okay?
lines.zh: : 那我这就去准备，马上回来！不过别太想我哦，好吗？

lines.en: scene mayamaid13
: I already miss her.
lines.zh: : 我已经开始想她了。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re the one who brought me to a maid cafe. You should know full-well how I’m going to act in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是你把我带到女仆咖啡厅来的。你早该清楚我在这种地方会是什么德行。

lines.en: : I knew it would be bad, but I didn’t think you’d propose within the first thirty seconds.
lines.zh: : 我知道会很糟，但没想到你头三十秒之内就求婚了。

lines.en: : And I didn’t think I’d meet the girl of my dreams.
lines.zh: : 我也没想到会遇到我梦中的女孩。

lines.en: scene mayamaid14
: You are aware that it’s all just an act, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这一切都只是演戏吧？

lines.en: : She’s just trying to coax more money out of you.
lines.zh: : 她只是想从你身上多哄点钱出来。

lines.en: : Of course I’m aware of that.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。

lines.en: : No idiot goes into a maid cafe without knowing that they’re going to be swindled. That’s like half of the charm.
lines.zh: : 没有哪个傻子进女仆咖啡厅还不知道自己要被宰的。这差不多就是这类地方一半的魅力所在。

lines.en: : So...you intend to just let her rob you?
lines.zh: : 所以……你打算就这么让她抢你？

lines.en: : If an undisclosed amount of desserts is the price to pay for a smile like that, I’ll buy them every day for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 如果为了那样的笑容，代价是数量不明的甜点，那我这辈子每天都买。

lines.en: scene mayamaid15
: I’m sure Ami would be thrilled to hear that.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Ami 听了会很高兴的。

lines.en: : Ami can never know that we came here together.
lines.zh: : 绝不能让 Ami 知道我们一起来过这里。

lines.en: : I have no intention of telling her that I willingly spent time with you, so that is fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我可没打算告诉她我是自愿跟你待在一起的，所以我没意见。

lines.en: : So, back to how cute you think maids are-
lines.zh: : 那么，回到你觉得女仆有多可爱这个话题——

lines.en: : No. Not back to that.
lines.zh: : 不。不许回到那个话题。

lines.en: : Have you ever considered working in a place like this? Because I think you could pull off the outfit really well.
lines.zh: : 你有没有考虑过来这种地方工作？我觉得你把那套制服撑得起来。

lines.en: scene mayamaid16
: What part of “Not back to that” don’t you understand?
lines.zh: : 「不许回到那个话题」，你到底有哪部分听不懂？

lines.en: : Of course I’ve never thought about working in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 我当然从来没想过在这种地方工作。

lines.en: : It’s annoying enough having to put on the shrine maiden dress every weekend. Putting on another, equally complicated uniform after that is far too much effort for me.
lines.zh: : 每个周末要穿巫女服就已经够烦了。之后再套另一套同样复杂的制服，对我来说太费事了。

lines.en: : But think about how cute you'd look.
lines.zh: : 但你想想你穿起来会有多可爱。

lines.en: : I am already cute. I don't need a costume to feel even more attractive.
lines.zh: : 我已经很可爱了。我不需要靠衣服来让自己更有吸引力。

lines.en: : Plus, if I had to even think about talking to anyone the way these maids are forced to, I’d probably burst into flames.
lines.zh: : 再说，光是想想要用这些女仆被迫用的那种方式跟人说话，我大概就会自燃。

lines.en: : Do you want to try calling me Master once to test it out?
lines.zh: : 你要不要试着叫我一声主人，试验一下？

lines.en: : Do you want to jump off of a bridge?
lines.zh: : 你要不要去跳桥？

lines.en: scene mayamaid17
: Hey! You be nice to him! That’s my Master you’re talking to!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你对我家主人客气点！

lines.en: Uta-chan comes back to the table to drop off Maya’s food. I fall in love again in the process.
lines.zh: Uta-chan 回到桌边把 Maya 的餐端上来。这个过程中我又恋爱了一次。

lines.en: scene mayamaid18
: Master, I’m so so sorry, but all of the desserts you ordered are gonna take a liiiiittle bit longer to prepare, okay?
lines.zh: : 主人，真的非常抱歉，不过您点的那些甜点要稍——微多花一点点时间准备，好吗？

lines.en: : The maid in the kitchen wasn’t expecting someone to be kind enough to order so many things, so she needs a teensy bit more time if that's okay.
lines.zh: : 厨房里的女仆没想到会有人好心到点这么多东西，所以她需要再多一丁点时间，可以吗？

lines.en: : I will wait forever if I have to.
lines.zh: : 必要的话，我可以永远等下去。

lines.en: scene mayamaid19
: Aww, shucks...You're too kind to me already...
lines.zh: : 呜哇，讨厌……您对我实在太好了……

lines.en: : Keep saying things like that and I might just fall for you.
lines.zh: : 你再这么说下去，我说不定就要爱上你了。

lines.en: : I’m going to be sick.
lines.zh: : 我要吐了。

lines.en: scene mayamaid20
: Not if I cast a spell on your meal, you won’t!
lines.zh: : 那可不行，我要给您的餐点施个魔法！

lines.en: : Why do you always do this? I just want to eat.
lines.zh: : 你为什么每次都要这样？我只想吃饭。

lines.en: : Because it’s my job, silly!
lines.zh: : 因为这是我的工作呀，傻瓜！

lines.en: : Please don't.
lines.zh: : 求你别。

lines.en: scene mayamaid21
: Happy days, happy nights, fill this meal with such delight~
lines.zh: : 快乐的日子，快乐的夜晚，让这顿饭充满喜悦～

lines.en: : Taste so sweet the girl will squeal...Uta-chan doth bless this meal!
lines.zh: : 甜得让女孩尖叫……Uta-chan 为这顿饭赐福！

lines.en: : Doth? Is this Shakespeare?
lines.zh: : 「赐福」？这是莎士比亚吗？

lines.en: scene mayamaid22
: FLAVOR BEEEEEEEAAAAAAAAAAM!!!!!!!!!
scene mayamaid23
: Can I eat now?
lines.zh: : 我现在能吃了吧？

lines.en: scene mayamaid24
: Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然可以！

lines.en: : Enjoy your meal, Princess!
lines.zh: : 祝您用餐愉快，公主！

lines.en: scene mayamaid25
Uta-chan disappears back into the kitchen and, once again, Maya and I are left on our own in the middle of a maid cafe.
lines.zh: Uta-chan 转身回厨房去了，于是又剩下我和 Maya 两个人待在女仆咖啡厅里。

lines.en: That is not a sentence I ever expected to think.
lines.zh: 这可是一句我从没想过自己会想出来的话。

lines.en: : Do you think she’ll cast the flavor beam on each one of my desserts?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她会对我每份甜点都放一次美味光波吗？

lines.en: : Most likely.
lines.zh: : 很可能。

lines.en: : She does it to the check as well.
lines.zh: : 她连账单都要放。

lines.en: : She uses the flavor beam on everything.
lines.zh: : 她对什么东西都要用美味光波。

lines.en: : She should cast it on you and see if it turns you into a more bright and cheerful person.
lines.zh: : 她该对你用一次，看看能不能把你变成一个开朗一点的人。

lines.en: : She’s tried before.
lines.zh: : 她试过了。

lines.en: : This is the result.
lines.zh: : 这就是结果。

lines.en: : Why do you keep coming here if you seem so annoyed by everything?
lines.zh: : 既然你对什么都这么不耐烦，为什么还一直来这儿？

lines.en: : I already told you. Cheap food, large portions.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。便宜，量大。

lines.en: : You have seen me eat. You must understand how much of a blessing this is.
lines.zh: : 你见过我吃饭的样子。你该明白这是多大的福气。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it make more sense to just...cook for yourself then? It would be cheaper, too.
lines.zh: : 那……自己做饭不是更合理吗？还更便宜。

lines.en: scene mayamaid26
: Cooking...may be a weakness of mine.
lines.zh: : 做饭……可能是我的弱项。

lines.en: : I have accepted this. Please do not torment me for it.
lines.zh: : 我已经接受了这一点。请不要拿这个来折磨我。

lines.en: : I won’t torment you. I can’t cook either.
lines.zh: : 我不会折磨你。我也不会做饭。

lines.en: : We can just force Ami to cook for us for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 那我们就逼 Ami 给我们做一辈子饭好了。

lines.en: : My only condition is that we eat in separate rooms.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的条件是我们在不同的房间里吃。

lines.en: : If you can agree to that, I will accept this proposition.
lines.zh: : 你要是能答应这个，我就接受这个提议。

lines.en: : I’ll draft the formal paperwork and have her sign it in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我会起草正式文件，明早让她签字。

lines.en: : Understood. It has been a pleasure doing business with you.
lines.zh: : 明白。跟你合作很愉快。

lines.en: scene black
Maya manages to finish her entire meal before Uta comes back with...way too many desserts.
lines.zh: 在 Uta 端着……多得离谱的甜点回来之前，Maya 已经把自己的那份吃得干干净净。

lines.en: After the flavor beam is cast on every one of them, Maya forces me to box them up so that she doesn’t have to stay and watch me eat everything in one sitting.
lines.zh: 每一份都被施过美味光波之后，Maya 硬要我把它们打包带走，这样她就不用坐在这儿看我一口气全吃下去。

lines.en: Obviously, I wouldn’t be able to do that even if I tried, so I wind up taking everything to go without much question.
lines.zh: 显然，就算我想那么做也做不到，于是我没怎么犹豫就把所有东西都打包带走了。

lines.en: We leave shortly after that...
lines.zh: 之后没多久我们就走了……

lines.en: But part of me wishes that I could have stayed and talked to my future wife for a little while longer...
lines.zh: 可我心里有一部分希望，能再多留一会儿，跟我未来的老婆多说几句话……

$ mayadorm25 = True
Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
